about_the_game:
Now Available in Early Access

Welcome to the Early Access version of ElfClash: Rescue Luna! Currently, you can click "New Game" on the main interface to begin your journey, explore the overworld map, and choose any stage to start your challenge.

The game features a Roguelike mode. You'll follow the core loop of "advancing through stages → experiencing card battles → visiting supply stations → proceeding to the next stage" as you progress across the overworld, pushing toward the final confrontation. If you fail during a run, the mission restarts, allowing you to assemble a new team and dive back into the adventure again and again.

We're releasing in Early Access to:

1. Gather player feedback - Your suggestions will directly help us improve the game

2. Develop with the community - You'll help shape the final form of the game

Pricing Explanation:

The launch 60% discount allows you to participate in the game's development at minimal cost. All future updates will be free for Early Access players.

Game Overview

ElfClash: Rescue Luna is a "simultaneous turn-based card battler." Each round, you must read the battlefield and select cards within your Energy limit to form a strategy that counters your opponent. Here, you'll use your wits to combine cards, unleash skills, and outmaneuver your foes. The unique projectile collision mechanic not only makes every encounter unpredictable but also adds a deep layer of strategic possibility, ensuring each duel feels fresh and thrilling.

Key Features

∙ Simultaneous Turns, Strategy First: Both sides plan their moves at the same time each round, composing attacks or defenses within their Energy limit. Outthink your opponent to claim victory.

∙ Dynamic Projectile Collisions: Launched projectiles can randomly collide mid-air, altering their trajectories. Triumph often hinges on your quick adaptation, moving beyond mere stat comparisons.

∙ Flexible Tactics, Freeform Deckbuilding: Combine defensive strategies like Light Barrier, Time Stop, and Whirlwind Field with offensive skills such as Multi-Shot and Elemental Magic to build your own unique tactical system.

∙ Assemble Heroes, Unleash Bond Effects: Recruit a diverse cast of heroes, each with unique skills. Clever team composition activates powerful bond effects, allowing you to create a one-of-a-kind elite squad.

∙ Grow Stronger, Intensity Rises: As you progress through stages and your heroes grow, projectile counts increase, collisions happen more frequently, and the combat pace steadily accelerates for an ever-more exhilarating experience.

Early Access Content

The current version includes the following substantial content for you to explore:

∙ Stages & Scenes: Over 30 meticulously designed stages across 7 distinct thematic maps.

∙ Roguelite-Style Ascension: More than 60 different pathing options, ensuring each run offers a unique adventure.

∙ Hero Roster: Unlock over 10 playable heroes, each with a unique skill system and 3 tiers of cosmetic skins.

∙ Card Strategy: A collection of 20+ skill cards spanning Attack, Defense, Magic, and Healing types, supporting a wide variety of play-styles and combos.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.5 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated (e.g., Intel Iris)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 15.2 (Sonoma) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro/Max / Intel i7
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated (e.g., AMD Radeon Pro)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Lead your team to delve into the Three Realms, rescue the abducted detective, retrieve the Energy Spirit Stone, and punish the nefarious forces hiding in the shadows. Each realm presents unique challenges and secrets, and your decisions will sway the course of the battle.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Korean
